stem.text: Limonene is found in lemon and orange oils.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of limonene: a cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on the C=C carbon and a prop-1-en-2-yl group on the opposite ring carbon; labelled limonene.
stem.label: limonene

stem.text: What will be the major product when limonene is reacted with an excess of dry hydrogen chloride?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and a Cl on the same ring carbon, and a prop-1-en-2-yl group on the opposite ring carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group on one ring carbon, a Cl on the adjacent ring carbon, and a prop-1-en-2-yl group on the ring carbon opposite the methyl.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and a Cl on the same ring carbon, and a 2-chloropropan-2-yl group on the opposite ring carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and a Cl on adjacent ring carbons, and a 1-chloropropan-2-yl group on the ring carbon opposite the methyl.
